steps.content: You fall asleep.
When you wake up, your heart skips a beat the moment you open your eyes, but as soon as you lift your head, you see Vanilla sitting across from you, smiling.

steps.speaker: Vanilla
steps.content: Do you remember what happened before you fell asleep?
Yeah... You told me to sleep, I said I wasn't tired, and then I fell asleep...

steps.speaker: Vanilla
steps.content: ...<size=28>Pfft</size>.
Your eyes meet, and after a few seconds, she turns her face and chuckles.
A few minutes later, you're sipping on hot soup made from canned goods stored at the camp. Vanilla has finished the "time check" at the camp and has returned.

steps.speaker: Vanilla
steps.content: Nothing out of the ordinary. It seems the storm is less intense today.

steps.speaker: Vanilla
steps.content: Don't worry about what happened this morning, you can fall asleep. As long as I'm still here, no matter what happens when you wake up, even if time has gone wrong, I will protect you.
Vanilla takes off the pocket watch from her chest and hands it to you.

steps.speaker: Vanilla
steps.content: The pollution in the temporal storm interferes with comms, so I've modified this pocket watch. You can use it to contact the camp.

options: Thank you, I feel safer now.

steps.speaker: Vanilla
steps.content: There's more, come with me.
She leads you to the workbench, picks up the exoskeleton armor on the table, and sizes it up on you for a bit.

steps.speaker: Vanilla
steps.content: Try it on.

steps.speaker: Vanilla
steps.content: How does it fit here? Does it feel tight?
Vanilla points to your chest. The armor here is the thickest, but it's lined with soft cotton padding. The size is just right and you don't feel any discomfort.
Seeing you give an okay sign, she hobbles around you a few more times.

steps.speaker: Vanilla
steps.content: Is it heavy?
You try jumping a few times. The armor makes some metal clinking sounds, but it doesn't feel heavy.
But Vanilla seems to have noticed something and grabs a wrench from the table. She works fast. In just half a minute, she has finished tweaking.

steps.speaker: Vanilla
steps.content: Try jumping again.
You jump again, this time the armor doesn't make any sound.

steps.speaker: Vanilla
steps.content: Hmm... is there anywhere else that feels weird?
You stretch your limbs, trying to feel this added "part" on your body. This armor, modified by Vanilla, fits perfectly and you can hardly feel any weight.
Every part of this armor moves as if it were part of your body. No wonder it can unleash such immense power when worn by Vanilla.

steps.speaker: Vanilla
steps.content: That's great.
Vanilla seems to remember something and reminds you:

steps.speaker: Vanilla
steps.content: You can search around the camp, but don't go too far.

steps.speaker: Vanilla
steps.content: This exoskeleton armor is just a transportation model, it can't support high-intensity combat. But I have added a power module to it. If you encounter a tough enemy, run as fast as you can, you hear?

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Loud and clear. But this was your armor, right? Did you stay up to modify it?

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: And if you gave me your armor, what about you then?

steps.speaker: Vanilla
steps.content: We have defense facilities in the camp. I never leave the camp anyway, so I don't need it.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Never? But didn't you leave the camp to save me?
She tilts her head and thinks for a moment.

steps.speaker: Vanilla
steps.content: You're right. Even machines go against their programming sometimes. So you have to be careful, don't put yourself in danger, or I will have to go out and find you.

steps.speaker: Vanilla
steps.content: Off you go. Be careful.
